title: The Great Physician
story:
A young boy loved playing soccer every evening.

One afternoon, while running after the ball, he tripped and fell.

His knee was badly scraped, and he began to cry.

His father quickly picked him up and carried him home.

His mother gently cleaned the wound, applied medicine, and covered it with a bandage.

The treatment stung for a moment, but within a few days, the wound healed.

The boy soon returned to the field, stronger and smiling again.

Just as loving parents care for an injured child, God cares deeply for His people.

Sometimes our wounds are not visible.

They may be hurts in our hearts, minds, or spirits.

God reveals Himself as the Lord who heals.

He brings healing, restoration, strength, and hope to all who trust in Him.

His healing touches not only our bodies but also our hearts and souls.
life_lesson: God is Jehovah Rapha—the Lord who heals. He lovingly restores our bodies, hearts, and lives as we trust in Him.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being the Lord who heals.

I bring every pain, weakness, worry, and broken place before You.

Please restore my heart, strengthen my faith, and guide me in Your ways.

Help me to trust Your perfect timing and unfailing love.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there an area of your life where you need God's healing today?

How have you experienced His restoring hand in the past?

How can you place your trust in the Great Physician each day?
verse: I am the Lord, who heals you.
